summary: Diageo plc filed a Form 6-K announcing the availability to shareholders of the Notice of Annual General Meeting 2026 and related Form of Proxy. The 2026 AGM is scheduled for Thursday, 5 November 2026 at 2:30pm at Convene 133 Houndsditch, London, held as a combined physical and electronic meeting via the Lumi platform. The Notice and proxy were submitted to the UK National Storage Mechanism and posted to the company website. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or deal terms are stated. This is a routine meeting notice, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle applies.
